description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'RegistrationEventQueueDao' responsible for interacting with the 'RegistrationEventQueue' entity in the database. It provides methods to save registration events, retrieve events by type, and fetch unpublished events with a limit.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing RegistrationEventQueue entities, including saving events, retrieving by type, and fetching unpublished events.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Persists a RegistrationEventQueue entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventByType
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent registration event of a specified type.

methods.name: getUnpublishedRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Fetches a list of unpublished registration events up to a specified limit.
